verdict.rationale: DPMA's own pages document electronic filing as an alternative to paper. DPMAdirektWeb lets you file trade marks and designs online without a signature card (dpma-docs-3, dpma-docs-6, dpma-docs-13). DPMAdirektPro covers all IP applications, including patents and EP/PCT transmissions, but needs a signature card (dpma-docs-4, dpma-docs-8, dpma-docs-9, dpma-docs-15). Missing for 10: online fee payment is not evidenced; patent filing needs a signature card and downloadable desktop software; the browser route is German-only; there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
